original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 recommends enabling WAL and optionally enabling flush_on_shutdown to handle the removal of max_transfer_retries configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-c6e07f70e7d9] shows that the actual upstream change is the removal of `max_transfer_retries` (`-ingester.max-transfer-retries`). It then lists alternatives to that setting. The cited text [ev-b19cd3bb8e8b] is option A, the preferred alternative, and [ev-8ec3d6c379c3] gives option B, flushing manually through the `/shutdown?flush=true` endpoint. Because enabling the WAL is one of two remediation options and is not mandatory, recording it as a migration-required step overstates the work an operator must do. This item has no change of its own: it is remediation guidance for the separate removal of `max_transfer_retries`.
